question: A study centre has 5 classes with 50, 60, 25, 40 and 70 students. The pass percentage of these 5 classes are 20%, 25%, 20%, 10%, 30%, respectively. Find the average number of students per class in the centre who passed.
solution:

Number of students in 5 classes: 50, 60, 25, 40, 70

Pass percentages for these classes: 20%, 25%, 20%, 10%, 30%

**Formula used:**

Number of students passed in each class = Total students in class × Pass percentage

Average number of students passed = Total number of students passed / Number of classes
